_verification_note: Site-ownership verification. Paste ONLY the token, or the entire <meta ...> tag you were given -- both are accepted. The tag is regenerated into the <head> of every indexable page on each deploy, so a rebuild can never silently un-verify the property. Verification must stay in place permanently: removing the token later makes the search engine drop ownership.
_verification_files_note: For the 'HTML file' method instead of the meta tag (Google Search Console, Bing). Map the exact filename to its exact contents; each is written to the site root on every build. Google's file is named googleXXXX.html and contains the single line 'google-site-verification: googleXXXX.html'.
_stripe_note: Create each product as a Stripe Payment Link, set its post-payment redirect to the delivery_url printed by build_pages.py, then paste the link URL into payment_link below. Change delivery_salt ONCE before your first sale; changing it later breaks existing customers' download links.

stripe._buy_button_note: Optional. Fill BOTH publishable_key (pk_live_... — publishable keys are safe in public HTML by design) and a product's buy_button_id to embed Stripe's checkout on the page instead of linking out. Leave blank to use plain Payment Links. NEVER put a secret key (sk_live_...) here.
